ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the entities and programs involved.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money is involved in these schemes?
ideas.insight: I believe that a thorough analysis of public records and data could reveal patterns and connections between entities that are not immediately apparent.
